metadata.description: Discover, stream and share music from independent artists.

home.title: Where independent sound finds its people.
home.subtitle: Discover, stream and share music straight from the artists who make it.

genres.title: Browse by genre
genres.errorBody: The catalog service didn't respond. Check your connection and try again.
genres.emptyBody: Genres will appear here once the catalog is set up.

newReleases.title: New releases
newReleases.emptyBody: New public tracks appear here as soon as artists publish them.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep listening.
login.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
login.resent: If the address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join VibeZone to follow artists and build playlists.
register.handleHint: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -. This is your public profile address.
register.displayNameHint: Shown on your profile. You can change it later.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works well.
register.successBody: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account. The link expires in 24 hours.
register.successHint: Didn't get it? Check spam, or request a new link from the sign-in page.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.successBody: Your account is active. You can sign in now.
verify.failedBody: It may have expired or already been used. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.successBody: If an account exists for {email}, a password reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.successBody: You've been signed out of all devices. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missing: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, password and signed-in devices.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Used for the interface and the emails we send you.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.subtitle: Sign out of devices you don't recognize.
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}

validation.handle: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -, starting and ending with a letter or number.

errors.invalid_refresh_token: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.handle_reserved: This username is reserved. Choose another.
errors.password_too_short: Password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.password_too_long: Password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.password_invalid: This password doesn't meet the requirements.
errors.token_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.registration_failed: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.
errors.session_not_found: That device is already signed out.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach VibeZone. Check your connection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.artist_exists: You already have an artist profile.
errors.artist_slug_invalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
errors.artist_bio_too_long: Bio must be at most 1000 characters.
errors.track_description_too_long: Description must be at most 2000 characters.
errors.track_not_uploadable: This track already has audio or is being processed.
errors.upload_in_progress: This track is already being processed.
errors.upload_length_required: The upload size is missing. Try again.
errors.upload_incomplete: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
errors.unsupported_file_type: This doesn't look like a supported audio file.
errors.duration_too_long: The audio is longer than 2 hours.
errors.corrupt_file: The file is damaged or not a real audio file.
errors.processing_attempts_exhausted: Processing failed several times. Try uploading again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This page failed to load. You can try again — if it keeps happening, please come back later.

track.waveformLabel: Waveform of {title}. Click to play from that point.
track.notFoundBody: It may be private, removed, or the link is wrong.

artist.label: Artist
artist.noTracksBody: This artist hasn't published anything public yet.
artist.notFoundBody: Check the link and try again.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Create tracks, upload audio and follow processing.
studio.emptyBody: Create your first track, then upload its audio.
studio.processing: Converting audio and computing the waveform… This page updates automatically.
studio.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}"? This can't be undone from the studio.

becomeArtist.title: Become an artist
becomeArtist.subtitle: Create your artist profile to upload and share music.
becomeArtist.name: Artist name
becomeArtist.slugHint: 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
becomeArtist.slugInvalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

visibilityHint.Public: Anyone can find and play it once it's ready.
visibilityHint.Unlisted: Only people with the link can play it; not shown in lists.

upload.choose: Choose an audio file or drop it here
upload.hint: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A/AAC, OGG/Opus or AIFF · up to {max} MB · up to 2 hours
